edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the stack passive means your carry's autos are CC in progress.
edits.after: Zilean's Time Bomb outranges you and pokes freely at level 1.

edits.before: Concussive trades begin: three hits and the stun votes; trade in stack windows.
edits.after: Level 2 double Time Bomb stuns and bursts past your engage range.

edits.before: Full kit: E eats their poke and W teleports the peel — the lane plays through your shield.
edits.after: Level 3 your Q slow and Concussive Blows exploit his bomb-cooldown gaps.

edits.before: Stack the margins — every traded auto is a quarter-stun; their math hates it.
edits.after: Through 4-5 it's a skill lane: your engage timing versus his revive timing.

edits.before: Glacial Fissure online — the line knockup starts dives and ends theirs.
edits.after: His level 6 Chronoshift un-kills whatever target you commit onto.

edits.before: First item: the wall hardens and the stack windows chain into kills.
edits.after: First item tank stats let you dive his immobile frame past the poke.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: By 2+ items his global revive and peel out-value your single-target lockdown.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Unbreakable banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Chronoshift (R) is 120/90/60s by rank — his revive undoes your kill; force it early or swap target once it glows. - Time Bomb (Q) is down 8-10s — trade in the gap right after he throws it. - Keep Unbreakable (E) for his double-bomb burst, not routine poke.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Every landed auto stacks Concussive Blows a quarter of the way — keep trading autos through his poke so the fourth stack lands on your timeline, not his.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Unbreakable only blocks from one direction — raising it after his Time Bomb has already ticked wastes the whole cast.
The revived target briefly can't take damage — don't dump your whole combo chasing it; wait the window out and refocus.
Race his Time Bomb for the knockup
Both Time Bomb and Glacial Fissure carry displacement — whoever lands theirs first owns the trade, so don't cast blind into his bomb range.
